title: Chapter 08 — Price Controls
desc: Binding and non-binding ceilings and floors, shortages and surpluses, non-price rationing, why controls get worse over time, and the minimum wage.
intro: A ceiling or floor only matters on one side of equilibrium. Once it binds, something other than price decides who gets the goods, and the damage grows the longer the control stays in place.
stats: 4 chunks · 2 live models · 4 checkpoints · 10-question practice exam
